Boundary — Fact: this intake implements nothing; the repository is empty, the run is unattended, and the request grants delivery to the repository, with no named deployed target. Visibility — Fact: the isolated source checkout remains at its snapshot until final return; after return, the tool and tests are usable from the delivered checkout, and the summary is visible when the CLI is run. Discovery — Fact: no team, workspace, channel, internal site, document, private repository, owner, sample, or prior run is named; any such source found later is a lead until verified. Risk — Assumption: an unstated CSV contract or consumer expectation could differ from the recorded defaults; any sensitive locator discovered belongs only in an authorized private store, never in committed KNOWLEDGE/."
